description.narrative: Tanzania, Uganda. Their idea is related to climate change and the need of creating sustainable livelihoods/more income generating sources that do not have a negative impact on the environment (TEG is in the Morogoro region close to the Uluguru mountain area in Tanzania, and ACOYDE in the Mbarara district South-West in Uganda). Economic skilling for women and youth which is in line with environmental conservation is the main objective of the project. TEG wants specifically to learn how to use banana fibres and banana stems (surplus from banana production- a huge income source in Tanzania) to make quality and income generating handicrafts, which ACOYDE have a lot of experience through their social enterprise CHACHA Banana Fiber Project. The teaching program ACOYDE provide for youth and women through the enterprise are constantly helping a huge amount of youth and women in Uganda with income from handicrafts. Participants will exchange crafting skills and teaching skills, as well as help developing organisational capacity. In general, they wish to increase knowledge and abilities related to ecological income generating sources. ACOYDE would like to learn more about running ecotourism project as a source of income, which TEG has a lot of experience from. They will also learn about forest conservation, and the use of storytelling to teach communities on climate change and how to engage in eco-tourism as a way of creating income as well as protecting nature.
